record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: BARBOACH (1 star) and WHISCASH (2 stars) declare FISSURE (maxPP 90, range 1) with passive AQUA_VEIL. Shared strategy; the difference is the star index (rift count and damage) and stats.
record.summary: Spawns a number of random rifts (2/3/4/6 by stars). Each rift picks a uniformly random cell of the whole 8x6 board (independent of the cast target and of the caster's half), and deals SPECIAL damage (25/50/75/100 raw by stars) to every occupied cell of the 3x3 block around it that holds an entity of another team. Rifts are independent: a unit standing in the overlap of several rifts is hit once per rift covering it, and a rift may cover no enemy at all. The cast target is only needed to start the cast (requiresTarget is true) and is not used by the damage. No status effect is applied.

targeting.who: random cells chosen with Math.random over the full board; occupied cells in the 3x3 block with an entity of another team than the caster's
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; the target argument is passed to super.process but not used by the strategy's damage. Selection before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: per rift: 3x3 square (Chebyshev radius 1) around a random board cell, clipped to the board, centre included; centres are drawn uniformly from x 0..7, y 0..5

effects.scaling: requested amount per hit = raw x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); multiplied by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); the same crit flag applies to every hit of the cast; AP does not change the number of rifts
effects.resolution: requested -> applied: each hit goes through handleSpecialDamage and handleDamage separately (SPE_DEF division with ceil and a minimum of 1 per hit, so several rifts on one unit do not combine before defence); the applied loss (takenDamage) is discarded by the strategy. Protect / skydiving / magicBounce targets take none on that hit (magicBounce queues a delayed bounce on the caster per blocked hit unless Protective Pads); a dead or resurrecting target takes none. Shield, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band branches are as for any special damage (see the BITE record). Expected hits per enemy are not computed here because positions and rift draws are not fixed.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; 3-star (4 rifts, 75), 4-star (6 rifts, 100) and the fallback are not reachable by the two listed units' bare star counts.

record.positionalConditions: The cast needs a target in range 1, but the rifts ignore its position. Rift centres can fall on empty cells, on the caster's side, on allies (skipped) or on board edges (clipped).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Every cast redraws all rift positions.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 25 (Barboach) / 50 (Whiscash) per hit, 2 / 3 rifts. Requested damage per hit = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then the per-hit SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers; the applied loss is discarded by the strategy.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - the SPECIAL speDef division was read, no probe was run
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: Whether board.getEntityOnCell can return a dead entity still on the board when a later rift of the same cast resolves was not traced (handleDamage ignores a unit at hp <= 0)
Random draws use Math.random through randomBetween; no seeding was found in the cited helper and none was searched for elsewhere
The AQUA_VEIL passive (RAIN: 60000 ms runeProtect on spawn) was read as listed; it does not alter the cast
Both units have passive AQUA_VEIL; no other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
